purpose: Teach: 鍛冶/臨場/北極/トップニュース/被写体/防い/訃報/何もの

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 伝統の、本気で、絶対、鍛冶、絶対、職人、絶対、刃物管理、絶対、警察、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We take the tradition of craftsmanship and blade management very seriously. The police are thorough in their verification. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slight weight on 'seriously' and 'thorough.' Deliberate pacing. The voice of someone who has given this statement before—professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事件現場の、本気で、絶対、臨場、絶対、感、絶対、捜査、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police are being really careful as they move through the investigation—taking in everything at the scene. I appreciate that approach.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slower pace. Genuine respect underneath—not performative. Quiet sincerity, like he's really thinking about what careful investigation means.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。北極、本気で、絶対、観測隊の、絶対、安全、絶対、関係機関、絶対、警察、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're coordinating closely with all the relevant agencies to ensure the safety of the Arctic observation team. It's a coordinated effort across multiple departments.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Slight formality—the language of official coordination. Even cadence. Confidence in the system without being defensive about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、トップニュース、絶対、扱い、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、大変ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: With this getting top-level news coverage, I imagine the pressure on the police response must be considerable.
lines.style: Genuine question underneath—not accusatory. Softer than procedural. A small acknowledgment of the weight on the shoulders of the people doing the work. Respectful lean-in.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。盗撮の、本気で、絶対、被写体、絶対、保護、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being thorough in protecting the identities and dignity of anyone involved in this case. That's non-negotiable for us.
lines.style: Firm but not defensive. Clear line drawn on this point. Professional pride in the work—the certainty that comes from knowing this is right. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、二次被害を、絶対、防いで、絶対、いらっしゃる、絶対、姿勢、絶対、ありがたいですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The way the police are working to prevent any secondary harm to those involved—that's something to be genuinely grateful for.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation. Slightly slower pace. He's really seeing the care behind the work, not just the procedure. Warm without being emotional. Sincere recognition.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。関係者の、本気で、絶対、訃報、絶対、警察、絶対、ご家族に、絶対、お伝えいたしました、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We were able to inform the family personally before any public statement. That was important to us.
lines.style: Slight softness here—this part mattered. A beat before speaking, acknowledging the weight of that conversation. Professional, but with the human care underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、何もの、絶対、なのか、絶対、警察、絶対、特定、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the investigation into who the suspect is—that's still ongoing, isn't it? The police are working to identify them.
lines.style: Careful curiosity. Not pressing, but present. The sense of leaning forward slightly, wanting to understand the progress. Patient pace. Genuine interest without impatience.
